title: Test Seedance 2.5’s ability to handle chaotic action by prompting high-stakes…
content:
Test Seedance 2.5’s ability to handle chaotic action by prompting high-stakes rescue operations while keeping shot details minimal.  
For a 30-second sequence, set shots to 6 and resolution to 480p to generate intense adrenaline scenes.
